title: Service Process Practice
originality_declaration: Created from scratch for this repository; not derived from a real exam or online question bank.

body.stem: A district service office wants to reduce repeated form filling for residents. Which action best reflects a service-oriented improvement?

options.text: Ask residents to submit the same identity information at every step.
Merge repeated fields, show progress clearly, and keep necessary review points.
Move every request to offline counters to avoid system changes.
Publish only internal processing rules and remove public status updates.

body.explanation: The best option improves usability while preserving necessary review. The exercise is an original platform sample, not a copied exam item.
